description.en: X-mount lenses under 200 grams — some lighter than your phone. Great for a light travel kit, a small gimbal, or simply keeping the camera in your hand instead of at the bottom of your bag.
description.zh: 重量不到 200 克的 X 卡口镜头，有些甚至比手机还轻。出门旅行减负、上小稳定器，或者只是想让相机待在手里而不是包底，看这一组就够。

shortDescription.en: Featherweight glass under 200 grams
shortDescription.zh: 不到 200 克，出门轻装无负担

description.en: X-mount primes measuring 35mm or less in barrel length. Flat pancakes, tiny wide-angles, and stubby normal lenses that slip into a jacket pocket and don't draw a second glance on the street — the shortest barely clear a body cap.
description.zh: 镜身长度不超过 35mm 的 X 卡口定焦。超薄饼干头、小广角和微型标头都在这里，塞进外套口袋正好，街头举起来也不显眼——最薄的几支几乎只比机身盖厚一圈。

shortDescription.en: Ultra-slim profiles for pocketable setups
shortDescription.zh: 极致轻薄，挂机无负担

description.en: Every X-mount prime opening to F1.4 or wider, from reliable everyday F1.4 autofocus lenses to exotic F0.95 manual glass. More light when the sun goes down, and cleaner separation when the background is busy.
description.zh: 最大光圈做到 F1.4 或更大的 X 卡口定焦，从主力级 F1.4 自动头到 F0.95「夜神」都有。天黑之后多留几档进光量，背景杂乱时也能稳稳把主体抠出来。

shortDescription.en: F1.4 and faster for bokeh and low light
shortDescription.zh: F1.4 及更大光圈，暗光与虚化都够用

description.en: Zooms that keep the same maximum aperture from wide to tele. Exposure doesn't dip as you zoom in, depth of field stays predictable across cuts in video, and the optics usually sit a tier above variable-aperture kit zooms.
description.zh: 从广角拧到长焦，最大光圈始终不变的一批变焦镜头。变焦时快门和 ISO 不用跟着跳，拍视频切换焦段时景深也连贯，整体光学素质通常比浮动光圈套机头高一档。

shortDescription.en: Fixed aperture across the zoom range
shortDescription.zh: 变焦全程光圈不缩水

description.en: X-mount lenses under $200 USD — characterful manual primes, tiny street pancakes, and a surprising number of native autofocus options. Cheap enough to try out a focal length you've never shot before without overthinking it.
description.zh: 千元以内的 X 卡口镜头精选。有好玩的手卷味手动头、紧凑的饼干头，也有不少原厂和副厂自动对焦镜头。花不了多少钱，就能把没玩过的焦段先摸一遍。

shortDescription.en: Good glass without breaking the bank
shortDescription.zh: 千元以内也有好镜头

description.en: The sweet spot for value on X-mount. Staying under $400 USD already gets you bright autofocus primes, handy everyday zooms, and solid options from both Fujifilm and third-party makers.
description.zh: X 卡口性价比最舒服的一档。两千元以内已经能挑到大光圈自动定焦、实用的日常变焦，原厂副厂都有，很多人的主力挂机头就在这儿。

shortDescription.en: The enthusiast sweet spot for value
shortDescription.zh: 主力挂机的性价比甜区

description.en: Native autofocus primes from Chinese makers like Viltrox, 7Artisans and TTArtisan. A few years ago this corner barely existed; today it spans featherweight everyday primes to flagship F1.2 optics, with focus motors edging closer to first-party speed each generation. Backed by solid optics and competitive pricing, it gives X-mount shooters far more native AF choice than the first-party lineup alone.
description.zh: 唯卓仕、七工匠、铭匠等国产品牌推出的原生自动对焦定焦合集。从轻巧的日常定焦到 F1.2 旗舰都已覆盖，对焦马达也在一代代逼近原厂。凭借扎实的光学素质与极具竞争力的定价，这类 AF 镜头正在快速壮大，为 X 卡口用户提供了远超以往的自动对焦选择。

shortDescription.en: From entry primes to flagship F1.2
shortDescription.zh: 从入门到 F1.2 旗舰

description.en: The manual-focus primes from Chinese makers like 7Artisans, TTArtisan and Brightin Star that open all the way to F1.2–F1.4. Mostly all-metal builds with a well-damped focus throw; wide open, they give you genuinely shallow depth of field and real low-light headroom. For anyone who wants the fast-aperture look and doesn't mind focusing by hand, it's an inexpensive way in.
description.zh: 七工匠、铭匠、星曜这些国产品牌的手动定焦里，最大光圈做到 F1.2–1.4 的一批。多为全金属机械手感，对焦阻尼讲究，开到最大光圈，浅景深明显，暗光下也更从容。想低成本玩玩大光圈的虚化和氛围、又不介意手动对焦，这一档很合适。

shortDescription.en: Fast F1.2–F1.4 manual primes
shortDescription.zh: F1.2–1.4 的大光圈手动定焦

description.en: An F0.95 aperture used to be the preserve of a few expensive "dream lenses." Now Chinese makers like 7Artisans, TTArtisan and Brightin Star have brought it down to a friendly price — wafer-thin depth of field and serious low-light gathering, for not much money. It's one of the most accessible ways to taste what a truly fast lens can do.
description.zh: F0.95 这种「夜神」级光圈，以前几乎是少数高价镜头的专利。如今七工匠、铭匠、星曜这些国产品牌把它做进了亲民价位——极浅的景深、暗光下充足的进光量，花不多的钱就能体验到，是大光圈尝鲜门槛较低的一档。

shortDescription.en: The F0.95 dream, within reach
shortDescription.zh: 够得着的「夜神」光圈

description.en: Manual primes from Chinese makers like 7Artisans, TTArtisan and Brightin Star — and there are a lot of them, in every focal length and rendering style, mostly all-metal. Prices run low enough that picking up a focal length you've never shot, or a look you're curious about, costs very little. The easy, cheap way to work through different focal lengths and rendering styles by hand.
description.zh: 七工匠、铭匠、星曜这些国产品牌的手动定焦数量众多、风格各异，多为全金属机械手感，价格却低到可以随手入。焦段从超广到中长都有，几百块就能添一支没玩过的焦段或没试过的成像风格——最适合用来低成本地把不同焦段和味道挨个试一遍。

shortDescription.en: A pure manual experience at a friendly price
shortDescription.zh: 纯手动体验，价格很友好

title.zh: 富士 XF 系列镜头

description.en: Fujifilm's pro-grade line and the best glass the system makes in-house. Most XF lenses get an aperture ring, faster and quieter focus motors, and weather sealing — the things XC goes without. The range is huge too, from F1.2-class fast primes to super-telephotos, so whatever you shoot, the first-party ceiling lives here.
description.zh: 富士 X 卡口的旗舰镜头线。相比 XC，XF 普遍配备物理光圈环、更高规格的对焦马达，多数型号做了防滴防尘。焦段覆盖也极全，从 F1.2 级大光圈定焦到超长焦一应俱全，是原厂体系里画质与操控能达到的上限。

shortDescription.en: Fuji's flagship glass — as good as first-party gets
shortDescription.zh: 原厂旗舰线，画质与操控的上限

title.zh: 富士 XC 系列镜头

description.en: Fujifilm's budget-friendly, lightweight line — the glass most bodies ship with. XC skips the aperture ring and trades the metal barrel for plastic, which keeps the price and the weight down, but you still get full autofocus, electronic communication with the body, and OIS on most of them. It's nearly all kit zooms, and an easy call when price or pack weight is what matters most.
description.zh: 富士原厂的轻量化入门线。XC 省去物理光圈环、改用复合材料镜身，价格和重量都明显低于 XF，但保留了完整的自动对焦与电子通讯，多数型号还内置 OIS 防抖。产品以套机变焦为主，是预算有限或对负重敏感时的实在选择。

shortDescription.en: Fuji's lightweight budget line — what most kits ship with
shortDescription.zh: 原厂轻量入门线，套机常见

title.zh: 适马 Contemporary 系列镜头

description.en: Sigma's take on small-but-sharp. At the heart of the line is a family of F1.4 primes from wide to short-telephoto, most designed from the ground up for APS-C rather than adapted from full-frame, so they stay genuinely compact — alongside compact constant-F2.8 zooms. They resolve beautifully, are built to last, and tend to undercut the competition on price.
description.zh: 适马主打高画质与小体积平衡的产品线。核心是覆盖广角到中长焦的 F1.4 大光圈定焦家族，多数为 APS-C 画幅原生设计，避开了全画幅转接的冗余体积；另有几支恒定 F2.8 紧凑变焦。锐度扎实、做工精致、定价克制。

shortDescription.en: Compact APS-C glass that doesn't trade away sharpness
shortDescription.zh: 高解析与小体积平衡的 APS-C 精品线

title.zh: 唯卓仕 Air 系列镜头

description.en: The Air series throws out the idea that fast glass has to be heavy. Most sit in the 170-gram class yet still give you an F1.7 aperture and proper autofocus. They all but vanish on the body — great for street, travel and run-and-gun video — and they're the obvious pick when you want to pack light but aren't ready to go all-manual.
description.zh: Air 系列打破了「大光圈必然重」的惯性：单支多在 170 克级，却给到 F1.7 光圈和原生自动对焦。挂在机身上几乎没有存在感，街拍、旅行、随手拍视频都顺手，适合想轻装、又不愿退回手动头的人。

shortDescription.en: Fast little AF primes that barely tip 170 grams
shortDescription.zh: 170 克级的原生自动对焦定焦

title.zh: 唯卓仕 Pro 系列镜头

description.en: The top of Viltrox's autofocus range, all built around a fast F1.2 aperture across the standard-to-portrait range. Metal barrels, weather sealing and USB-C firmware updates round out the package. The subject separation and low-light reach go toe-to-toe with Fuji's best primes, for a good deal less money.
description.zh: 唯卓仕自动对焦体系里的旗舰序列。Pro 系列以 F1.2 超大光圈立足，覆盖标准到人像焦段，全金属镜身、防滴防尘、支持 USB-C 固件升级。极致的主体分离与暗光表现，用明显更低的价格直接对标原厂顶级定焦。

shortDescription.en: F1.2 flagships that go head-to-head with Fuji's own
shortDescription.zh: F1.2 旗舰定焦，正面对标原厂

title.zh: 福伦达 Nokton 系列镜头

description.en: Voigtländer's long-running line of fast manual-focus primes, spanning F1.2 to F0.9. All-metal barrels with a beautifully damped focus throw, and a classic, characterful look wide open rather than clinical sharpness. These are for shooters who enjoy slowing down and focusing by hand.
description.zh: 福伦达旗下的大光圈手动定焦序列，光圈从 F1.2 到 F0.9。全金属对焦螺旋手感细腻，全开光圈下带有古典的氛围与柔和焦外。是为享受手动对焦仪式感、追求画面性格的玩家准备的。

shortDescription.en: Voigtländer's fast manual primes, built for character
shortDescription.zh: 大光圈手动定焦的经典序列

title.zh: 思锐 Sniper 系列镜头

description.en: Sirui's F1.2 autofocus primes, priced well below most other F1.2 autofocus lenses on X-mount. Many aperture blades keep out-of-focus highlights round as you stop down. They skip the aperture ring and weather sealing, keeping the focus on a fast aperture for the money.
description.zh: 思锐的 F1.2 自动对焦定焦，价格明显低于 X 卡口上大多数 F1.2 自动对焦镜头。光圈叶片多，收小光圈后焦外光斑依然圆润。没有光圈环，也不防滴防尘，钱都花在了大光圈上。

shortDescription.en: Affordable F1.2 autofocus primes
shortDescription.zh: 平价的 F1.2 自动对焦定焦

description.en: 23mm on APS-C gives the classic 35mm full-frame view — wide enough to keep the street and environment in the frame, tight enough for a half-body shot without stretching faces. Here's every 23mm prime on X-mount, first-party and third-party alike.
description.zh: 23mm 在 APS-C 上等效全画幅 35mm，经典的人文与纪实视角。能交代出足够的现场环境，拍半身也不会明显拉变形。X 卡口原厂和各家副厂的 23mm 定焦都在这页。

shortDescription.en: 35mm equiv — street and environmental portraits
shortDescription.zh: 等效 35mm，扫街与旅拍万金油

description.en: The Nifty Fifty of the Fujifilm system. 35mm on X-mount gives a natural 50mm-equivalent perspective that feels effortless to frame with — and because it's the most crowded focal length on the mount, choices run from cheap manual gems to weather-sealed F1.4 flagships.
description.zh: 富士系统的「标头」。等效全画幅 50mm 的视角自然克制，拿起来不太需要琢磨构图怎么切。这也是 X 卡口最热闹的焦段，从几百块的好玩手动头到三防 F1.4 旗舰应有尽有。

shortDescription.en: 50mm equiv — the classic standard prime
shortDescription.zh: 等效 50mm，最耐看的标头焦段

description.en: Sitting halfway between a 35mm standard prime and an 85mm portrait lens, 50mm on APS-C acts like a 75mm equivalent. Great for tighter street frames, still life, and portraits where you want moderate compression without shouting across the street.
description.zh: 卡在标头和 85mm 人像头中间，50mm 在 APS-C 上等效约 75mm。带一点空间压缩感又不用退太远，拍街头特写、静物小品、带环境的人像都很顺手，属于用过才知道香的焦段。

shortDescription.en: 75mm equiv — tight frames and portraits
shortDescription.zh: 等效 75mm，进可人像退可特写

description.en: The go-to portrait focal length on X-mount. At an 85mm full-frame equivalent, it flatters faces without distortion, melts busy backgrounds cleanly, and keeps a comfortable distance from your subject.
description.zh: 富士系统里正经的人像王牌焦段。等效全画幅 85mm，脸型不会透视变形，背景虚化也够干净，和被摄者之间还能保持一个彼此舒服的拍摄距离。

shortDescription.en: 85mm equiv — the portrait focal length
shortDescription.zh: 等效 85mm，富士人像王牌焦段

description.en: 85mm on APS-C reaches a tight 128mm equivalent — true telephoto prime territory. It strips away messy backgrounds and pulls distant details right to the front. A niche pick on crop sensors, yet each lens here has a distinct character.
description.zh: 在 APS-C 上等效约 128mm，已经跨进真正的中长焦领域。杂乱的背景几乎能被一键抹平，主体被直接推到镜头前。半画幅上用 85mm 算小众玩法，但现有的这几支都挺有个性。

shortDescription.en: 128mm equiv — telephoto subject isolation
shortDescription.zh: 等效 128mm，强力压缩与背景净化

description.en: Every X-mount prime at 18mm or wider — from fast night-sky workhorses and crisp landscape lenses to ultra-wide glass below 10mm for dramatic perspective.
description.zh: 18mm 及更广的 X 卡口广角定焦。风光、星空、建筑、室内需要把画面撑开时从这里挑——既有大光圈暗光主力，也有 10mm 以下专门制造强烈透视张力的超广角。

shortDescription.en: 18mm and wider for architecture and landscapes
shortDescription.zh: 18mm 及更广，风光、建筑与星空

description.en: Zooms starting at 12mm or wider on APS-C. Handy for tight interiors, architecture, and big landscapes where you have no room to step back and don't want to keep swapping primes.
description.zh: 广角端下探到 12mm 及以下的变焦镜头。室内空间退无可退、或者拍大风光和建筑需要微调边框时，有一支广角变焦比来回换定焦省事得多。

shortDescription.en: Ultra-wide zooms for interiors and architecture
shortDescription.zh: 超广变焦，室内与建筑利索搞定

description.en: The 15–55mm workhorse range on APS-C, taking you from casual wide shots to short-telephoto portraits without changing lenses. Often the first lens on a new body, and the one you reach for when versatility wins.
description.zh: 覆盖 APS-C 黄金中段（约 15–55mm）的标准变焦，从小广角扫街到中焦半身人像一支搞定。通常是新机到手的第一支挂机头，也是出门不想频繁换镜头时的稳妥选择。

shortDescription.en: The everyday workhorse zoom range
shortDescription.zh: 日常挂机最顺手的标准变焦

description.en: Big-ratio zooms that stretch from wide-angle to telephoto in one barrel. You give up a bit of aperture and corner sharpness, and in return you don't miss shots while fumbling with lens caps on the road.
description.zh: 从广角一口气拉到长焦的大变焦比旅游头。拿一点边缘锐度和光圈换全程不断档的焦段覆盖，在边走边拍、没工夫换镜头的旅途里最管用。

shortDescription.en: One lens for the entire trip
shortDescription.zh: 一支走天下，旅途少换镜头

description.en: Zooms starting at 50mm and reaching deep — from compact walk-around telephotos for street details and portraits to long F2.8 and wildlife zooms built for distance and compression.
description.zh: 广角端从 50mm 起步的长焦变焦，自带压缩感。从轻便的日常半身人像变焦，到 F2.8 专业头和拍鸟拍运动的远摄型号都在这里。

shortDescription.en: Reach for portraits, sports, and wildlife
shortDescription.zh: 长焦变焦，人像压缩与生态远摄

description.en: Zooms that keep the same length from one end of the range to the other: the barrel never extends, so the balance stays put on a gimbal, nothing pumps air or dust in as you zoom, and the lens cannot creep out when pointed down. Most of them are weather-sealed professional zooms, from ultra-wide to long telephoto.
description.zh: 变焦时镜身长度不变的变焦镜头：镜筒不伸缩，装在稳定器上重心不跑，变焦时不会把空气和灰尘吸进镜身，朝下拿时也不会自己滑出来。这里多是带防滴防尘的专业变焦，从超广角到长焦都有。

shortDescription.en: Zooms that never change length
shortDescription.zh: 变焦不伸缩，稳定器友好

description.en: X-mount lenses marked with full or partial weather sealing — handy alongside a sealed body in rain, dust, or cold. Sealing standards vary a lot between makers (some only gasket the mount), so check the details before taking one into a downpour.
description.zh: 标注了防滴防尘的 X 卡口镜头。配一台三防机身，下雨、起风沙或低温天气出门心里有底不少。不过各家标准差得挺多，有的关键部位全密封，有的只在卡口加一圈胶条，真要淋雨前还是得看清具体规格。

shortDescription.en: Built for rain, dust, and cold
shortDescription.zh: 雨雪、风沙天出门更安心

description.en: Every X-mount lens with built-in optical stabilization — OIS on Fujifilm, VC on Tamron, OS on Sigma. Useful for steadier handheld video and slower shutter speeds in dim light, especially if your body has no IBIS.
description.zh: 内置光学防抖的 X 卡口镜头（富士叫 OIS，腾龙叫 VC，适马叫 OS）。原理都是靠内部浮动镜组抵消手抖——机身没防抖、或者用长焦和慢快门手持时，带不带防抖差别很大。

shortDescription.en: Built-in stabilization for video and low light
shortDescription.zh: 内置光学防抖，暗光手持与视频更稳

description.en: Glass reaching 300mm full-frame equivalent or beyond — for wildlife, birds, planes, and motorsports when your feet simply can't get you any closer.
description.zh: 等效全画幅 300mm 以上的长焦与变焦镜头。拍野生动物、打鸟、拍飞机或赛车这种脚走不过去的场景，主要靠这一档把画面拉近。

shortDescription.en: 300mm+ equiv for wildlife and aviation
shortDescription.zh: 等效 300mm 以上，打鸟与远摄

description.en: Manual lenses built for video and cinema rigs — T-stop markings, geared focus and iris rings, and matched front diameters for follow-focus and matte boxes, from Fujifilm's MKX zooms to third-party cine primes.
description.zh: 专为视频和电影拍摄设计的 X 卡口镜头，通常标 T 值光圈、带跟焦齿轮环，并尽量统一前口径方便装遮光斗和跟焦器。收录富士 MKX 电影变焦以及各家第三方电影定焦。

shortDescription.en: Geared rings, T-stops, and matched front diameters
shortDescription.zh: T 值、齿轮环、统一前口径

description.en: Circular and diagonal fisheyes with bold barrel distortion and huge depth of field — made for skate videos, night skies, cramped interiors, and shots where straight lines are supposed to bend.
description.zh: 涵盖圆形与对角线鱼眼的 X 卡口超广角。夸张的桶形畸变加上极深的景深，拍滑板视频、星空穹顶，或者故意让画面线条弯出张力时很出彩。

shortDescription.en: Ultra-wide barrel distortion for creative shots
shortDescription.zh: 极端广角，让直线弯出张力

description.en: Manual lenses that tilt or shift the optical axis relative to the sensor. Tilt tips the plane of focus for selective sharpness or miniature looks; shift keeps tall buildings and products straight without leaning back.
description.zh: 支持倾斜（Tilt）或平移（Shift）调整的特殊镜头。倾斜用来转动焦平面，拍微缩「小人国」效果或斜向合焦；平移能在仰拍建筑和商业产品时直接把竖线拉直，虽然小众，但干活时无可替代。

shortDescription.en: Focal plane tilt and perspective shift
shortDescription.zh: 转动焦平面与拉直建筑透视

description.en: Close-focusing lenses with high magnification (0.5×, 1×, and beyond) — built for bugs, flowers, watches, food, and textures your regular lens simply won't focus close enough to frame.
description.zh: 具备极近对焦距离和高放大倍率（常见 0.5×、1× 甚至更高）的微距镜头。拍昆虫、花草、手表美食或表面纹理时，普通镜头怼不近的细节，它们能直接铺满画面。

shortDescription.en: Close-up detail for products, food, and nature
